E_aggregated.action_count_comment: No tool list exists for the input path /mcp. The input endpoint has no own evidence: every path on mcp.factset.com, including the host root, answers HTTP 401, and the protected-resource metadata simply echoes the requested path. The product in the CSV documentation (FactSet AI-Ready Data MCP) is documented only at https://mcp.factset.com/content/v1, for which the Claude connector directory (made by FactSet, Anthropic verified) lists 23 tools. Following the prompt rule for an input endpoint without own evidence, these 23 tools are recorded as best available evidence, labelled [ENDPOINT /content/v1] and third-party. developer.factset.com pages render only with JavaScript and could not be read.

contradictions: The input endpoint is https://mcp.factset.com/mcp, while FactSet's AI-Ready Data MCP documentation listings identify https://mcp.factset.com/content/v1. The input path has its own OAuth protected-resource metadata, so the documented path's tools are not assigned to /mcp.

The Claude directory and Labsco list 24 tools for /content/v1; APIs.io lists 10 differently named tools for that same documented path. The discrepancy may reflect different inventories or listings; no public tool schemas were found to resolve it.

The launch announcement describes access to nine initial dataset domains, while the 24-tool listing names additional tool categories. The sources may describe different release snapshots or granularity; chronology and tool-to-domain mapping were not resolved.

FactSet's Developer Portal pages returned client-rendered shells in the prepared evidence, and their associated content API was inaccessible through the browser tool; consequently the official tool catalog could not be independently extracted from those pages.
The CSV endpoint is https://mcp.factset.com/mcp, but FactSet AI-Ready Data MCP is listed (Claude directory, APIs.io) only at https://mcp.factset.com/content/v1.
observations_for_research: OAuth metadata is available for the supplied path even though public tool documentation found in this search targets a different path on the same host.
